items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: Obama says he likes John Coltrane... I never ever heard a president speak of John Coltrane.

ctx.x: About eight days he’s been, eight or nine days. I wonder how — you guys have any —

It feels even better because Obama says he likes John Coltrane. You know that’s even feeling better, because he said, in one of his speeches, that he gave his brother-in-law “A Love Supreme.” Because he was playing, see he was playing a lot of music, man, he’d say, “Now I really want you to hear something.” He’s trying to get his music together. He said “I want you to really hear something really great.” So he said, “I gave him John Coltrane’s ‘A Love Supreme’.” So right there, when Obama said that I go like wow,…
I didn’t know such a thing existed.
